blocks.source: 2004年発売の空の軌跡からかれこれ１３年。軌跡シリーズとしては８作目となる。
blocks.translation: It has been about 13 years since Trails in the Sky was released in 2004. This is the eighth installment in the Trails series.

blocks.source: 続編物なので閃の軌跡１～２のプレイは必須。ストーリー重視のゲームなので、３からやるのは明らかに無謀。漫画や小説を途中の巻から読むようなものなので。
blocks.translation: Since this is a sequel, playing Trails of Cold Steel I–II is essential. This is a story-focused game, so starting with III would clearly be reckless. It would be like reading a manga or novel starting from a volume in the middle.

blocks.source: 主人公リィンも続投なので、過去作をやっているかどうかで感情移入度が全然違うと思う。
blocks.translation: Since protagonist Rean also returns, I think your ability to relate to him is completely different depending on whether you have played the previous games.

blocks.source: 空の軌跡、零＆碧の軌跡のキャラがたくさん登場するのもファン感涙。
blocks.translation: Fans will also be moved to tears by the many characters from Trails in the Sky and Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure who appear.

blocks.source: 特に零＆碧の舞台となったクロスベル市も大きく関わってくるので、あちらもできればプレイしておきたい。空の軌跡１～３も、思ったより関わって来るのでできれば。
blocks.translation: In particular, Crossbell City, the setting of Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure, plays a major role, so if possible, you should play those games as well. Trails in the Sky I–III also have more involvement than expected, so playing them would be preferable.

blocks.source: トールズ士官学院を卒業したリィンは、新設された分校の教官として赴任することになる。
blocks.translation: After graduating from Thors Military Academy, Rean is assigned as an instructor at its newly established branch campus.

blocks.source: 中心となるのが新VII組の生徒達５人であり、感覚は閃１に近い。同じことを繰り返している感はあれど、マンネリ感の漂っていた閃２よりも新鮮に遊べるようになっている。
blocks.translation: The five students of the new Class VII are at the center, giving it a feel closer to Trails of Cold Steel I. Although it feels like the same things are being repeated, it is fresher to play than Trails of Cold Steel II, which had begun to feel stale.

blocks.source: とはいうものの、登場人物の大半が既存キャラなのも事実。主要の新キャラ４人や学院関係のキャラを除けば、ほとんどが再登場だと思ってもよいくらい。
blocks.translation: That said, it is also true that most of the cast consists of existing characters. Aside from the four major new characters and characters connected to the academy, you could almost assume that nearly everyone is returning.

blocks.source: 再登場組では、生徒となるアルティナやオーレリア分校長など前作で掘り下げの薄かったキャラにも大きくスポットが当てられている。アルティナに至っては、ほとんどメインヒロイン級の扱いだったのが驚き。
blocks.translation: Among the returning characters, significant attention is given to characters who received little development in the previous game, such as Altina, who becomes a student, and Branch Principal Aurelia. Altina in particular was treated almost like the main heroine, which was surprising.

blocks.source: 個人的によかったのは、過去作のサブイベントに関連した生徒達が社会人となって再登場したこと。『個性のあるモブ』くらいのポジションだった彼らが、声付きのイベントシーンで登場してくる。
blocks.translation: What I personally liked was that students connected to sub-events in previous games reappeared as working adults. They had occupied positions like “colorful NPCs,” but now they appear in voiced event scenes.

blocks.source: 過去作で会話をしっかり聞いていたプレイヤーなら、感激できると思う。そうでないプレイヤーにとっては「こいつ誰だっけ？」状態になる可能性もあるけど……。
blocks.translation: Players who paid close attention to the conversations in the previous games will probably be deeply moved. For players who did not, however, it may become a case of, “Who was this guy again?” …

blocks.source: キャラクター同士のやり取りは相変わらず充実しており、掘り下げも丁寧。
blocks.translation: The interactions between the characters remain abundant, and their development is handled carefully.

blocks.source: 新しい環境で四苦八苦している主人公が、過去の仲間達と再会するシーンはとても感慨深いものがある。
blocks.translation: The scene where the protagonist, struggling in a new environment, reunites with his former companions is deeply moving.

blocks.source: 学院や町での会話も、いつも以上に細かく作り込まれている。マップを一通り回って、主要人物の会話を聞くだけで数時間が過ぎていたり。
blocks.translation: The conversations at the academy and in the towns are also crafted in greater detail than ever. I sometimes spent several hours simply making the rounds of the maps and listening to the main characters’ conversations.

blocks.source: ストーリーが進行したらまたサブイベントが刷新されたりで、これまた相当な量になっている。
blocks.translation: Whenever the story progressed, the sub-events were refreshed again, making for a considerable amount of content.

blocks.source: サブイベントの大半をこなすようなプレイスタイルで、クリアまで丁度１００時間（難易度はノーマル）もかかった。※ただし、料理などは面倒だったので放置。
blocks.translation: Playing in a style that involved completing most of the sub-events, it took me exactly 100 hours to clear the game (on Normal difficulty). ※However, I left things like cooking untouched because they were tedious.

blocks.source: 閃１～２はそこまでかからなかったので、ボリュームが増してるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Trails of Cold Steel I–II did not take quite that long, so the amount of content may have increased.

blocks.source: ……で、そこまではよかったのだけど、ストーリーの本筋には色々と問題も。
blocks.translation: ……And things were good up to that point, but the main storyline also has various problems.

blocks.source: まず気になったのはテンプレ描写の異様な多さ。散々突っ込まれた閃の軌跡２を上回る勢いである。
blocks.translation: The first thing that stood out was the absurd abundance of formulaic scenes. It surpasses even Trails of Cold Steel II, which was heavily criticized for this.

blocks.source: 閃の軌跡３テンプレの数々
blocks.translation: The Many Trails of Cold Steel III Tropes

blocks.source: ピンチになると毎度助っ人が来てくれる。
blocks.translation: A helper comes to the rescue every time things get desperate.

blocks.source: 「リィン、助けに来たぞ！」
blocks.translation: "Rean, I came to help!"

blocks.source: 敵キャラはまず最初から本気を出さない。
blocks.translation: The enemy never starts by fighting seriously.

blocks.source: 戦闘でどれだけフルボッコにしても、敵キャラは余裕しゃくしゃく。
blocks.translation: No matter how thoroughly you pummel them in battle, the enemy remains completely at ease.

blocks.source: 「少しはやるようだが、その程度で俺は倒せん」
blocks.translation: "You seem to have some skill, but you cannot defeat me with that."

blocks.source: 敵であろうと名前付きのキャラが死ぬことは滅多にない。
blocks.translation: Even named enemy characters rarely die.

blocks.source: 敵キャラを何度倒しても退場してくれない。神速のデュバリィとか何回目よ？
blocks.translation: No matter how many times you defeat an enemy character, they never leave the stage. How many times has Duvalie the Swift shown up now?

blocks.source: 人間での戦いが終われば騎神を召喚。とってつけたようにロボ戦が始まる。
blocks.translation: Once the battle between humans ends, a Divine Knight is summoned. Then a robot battle starts, tacked on as if by obligation.

blocks.source: 「来い、ヴァリマール！」
blocks.translation: "Come, Valimar!"

blocks.source: ただし、騎神召喚と見せかけて助っ人が入るパターンも多数。
blocks.translation: However, there are also many cases where a helper appears instead of the expected Divine Knight summon.

blocks.source: 「来い、ヴァリマール！」「その必要はない」
blocks.translation: "Come, Valimar!” “That won’t be necessary."

blocks.source: 第三者が遠くから高みの見物をしている。
blocks.translation: A third party watches from afar, looking down on the proceedings.

blocks.source: 「あれが噂にあったVII組の連中か……。少しは楽しませてくれそうだな」
blocks.translation: "So those are the members of Class VII I’ve heard rumors about…… They look like they might provide some entertainment."

blocks.source: 実力者はその第三者の気配を感じ取れる。
blocks.translation: The skilled can sense the presence of that third party.

blocks.source: 「フッ、どうやら観客が来ているようだね」
blocks.translation: "Heh, it seems we have an audience."

blocks.source: やたらと察しがよい登場人物。基本的に「察しのよさ＝キャラの格」である。
blocks.translation: Characters who are remarkably perceptive. Basically, “perceptiveness = status as a character.”

blocks.source: 「君達はトールズ士官学院の者だね？」「えっ、どうしてそれを！？」
blocks.translation: "You’re from Thors Military Academy, aren’t you?” “Huh? How did you know that!?"

blocks.source: 会話が気まずい時は「あ……（察し）」が基本。
blocks.translation: When a conversation gets awkward, the standard response is, “Ah…… (I see).”

blocks.source: 「俺の親父は五年前に死んだんだ」「あ……」
blocks.translation: "My old man died five years ago." "Oh..."

blocks.source: みたいな感じで使う。
blocks.translation: Used in situations like this.

blocks.source: 他にも意表を突かれた時など、様々な場面で多用する。
blocks.translation: It is also used frequently in various situations, such as when caught off guard.

blocks.source: 主人公リィンはとりあえずモテる。好意を寄せるキャラは一桁に留まらない。
blocks.translation: The protagonist, Rean, is popular with the ladies. The number of characters who harbor feelings for him is well into the double digits.

blocks.source: 特に妹・皇女・ミュゼの三人娘の描写はかなりクドい。
blocks.translation: The portrayals of the three girls in particular—his sister, the princess, and Musse—are extremely overdone.

blocks.source: ここまでくると、もはやネタとしてやっているのかもしれない。
blocks.translation: At this point, perhaps they are doing it purely as a running gag.

blocks.source: なお、実際のイベントは↓こんな感じになる。
blocks.translation: For reference, the actual events play out something like this ↓.

blocks.source: ボス「よく来たな。かかってこい」
blocks.translation: Boss "You've come at last. Come and get me."

blocks.source: 主人公「みんな、行くぞ！」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Everyone, let's go!"

blocks.source: （ボス戦）
blocks.translation: (Boss battle)

blocks.source: ボス「まだまだだな。そろそろ本気を出すとしよう」
blocks.translation: Boss "You're still no match for me. I think it's time I got serious."

blocks.source: （ボス第二形態）
blocks.translation: (Boss's second form)

blocks.source: 主人公「くっ、手強い……！」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Damn, they're tough...!"

blocks.source: （ノーダメージの楽勝でも膝をついて苦戦した雰囲気）
blocks.translation: (Creates the impression of a difficult battle by having them kneel, despite an easy victory without taking damage)

blocks.source: ボス「なかなかやるな。だがこれで条件はそろったぞ！ 来い神機！」
blocks.translation: Boss "You're pretty good. But now all the conditions are in place! Come forth, Divine Machine!"

blocks.source: （敵のロボ登場）
blocks.translation: (Enemy robot appears)

blocks.source: 主人公「くっ、このままではやられる」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Damn, we'll be defeated at this rate."

blocks.source: 助っ人「助けに来たぞ！」
blocks.translation: Ally "I came to help!"

blocks.source: 主人公「みんなありがとう。今だ、騎神召喚！」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Thanks, everyone. Now! Knight God Summon!"

blocks.source: （味方のロボ登場で騎神戦）
blocks.translation: (Knight God battle after an allied robot appears)

blocks.source: ボス「思ったよりやるが、想定の範囲内だ。ところでそこに誰か隠れているな？」
blocks.translation: Boss "You're better than I expected, but still within the anticipated range. By the way, someone is hiding there, aren't they?"

blocks.source: 主人公「なに！？」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "What!?"

blocks.source: （どこからともなく現れる謎の第三者）
blocks.translation: (A mysterious third party appears out of nowhere)

blocks.source: 第三者「ふっ、私の存在によくぞ気づいた」
blocks.translation: Third Party "Heh, well done noticing my presence."

blocks.source: 主人公「いったい何者なんだ！？」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Who in the world are you!?"

blocks.source: 第三者「相手をしてやりたいところだが、今日は顔見せなので、この辺にしておいてやろう。さらばだ」
blocks.translation: Third Party "I'd like to deal with you, but I'm only showing my face today, so I'll let you off here. Farewell."

blocks.source: ボス「俺も用事は済んだので、さらばだ」
blocks.translation: Boss "I've finished what I came here to do as well, so farewell."

blocks.source: 主人公「待て、質問に答えろ！」
blocks.translation: Protagonist "Wait! Answer my question!"

blocks.source: やや極端に書いたけど、全体的にこんな感じのイベントが多め。一イベントに詰め込んでいる上に、展開がテンプレかつ決着もつかない、しかも謎は明かさないのでグダグダしている印象を受けた。
blocks.translation: I wrote it somewhat extremely, but there are many events like this overall. They cram so much into a single event, while the developments are formulaic and never reach a conclusion. On top of that, they never reveal the mysteries, leaving the impression that everything just drags on.

blocks.source: 序盤は敵味方ともに怒涛の勢いで人物が登場。多人数の入り乱れる派手なイベントが展開する。……のだけど、冷静になれば、みんな思わせぶりなことを言っているだけで、ロクに話が進んでないなんてことも。
blocks.translation: At the beginning, characters from both sides—friend and foe alike—appear in a torrent. Flashy events unfold with large numbers of characters caught up in the chaos. ...Or so it seems, but when you take a step back, everyone is merely saying suggestive things, and sometimes the story barely moves forward at all.

blocks.source: 話を引っ張りまくるシナリオの都合上、すっきりとした解決がなされることが少ない。
blocks.translation: Because the scenario keeps dragging things out, it rarely provides a clear-cut resolution.

blocks.source: そうやって、後半まで同じような展開を繰り返す。何をやっても、誰かの手の平の上という感覚も否定できない。
blocks.translation: The same kind of developments continue repeating all the way into the second half. No matter what you do, it is hard to deny the feeling that you are merely playing into someone else's hands.

blocks.source: 脇の会話はよくできているのに、肝心な部分が色々とまずい。ライターの得意不得意があるのか、分業しているせいなのか……。随分と出来不出来に差がある印象。
blocks.translation: The side conversations are well done, yet the crucial parts are problematic in many ways. Is it a matter of each writer's strengths and weaknesses, or is it because the work was divided among multiple writers...? The quality varies considerably.

blocks.source: そして、軌跡シリーズといえば、半端な終わり方をすることで悪名高い。
blocks.translation: And speaking of the Trails series, it is infamous for ending in an incomplete fashion.

blocks.source: 本作はどうかというと――今までにも増して酷いの一言。
blocks.translation: As for this installment—there is only one way to describe it: even worse than before.

blocks.source: 上記のように何十時間にも渡って「進んでいるような、いないような展開」を繰り返すが、後半になってようやく話が進み出す。閃１～２で広げた風呂敷を、少しずつ畳む兆候が見えてきて、盛り上がってくる。
blocks.translation: As mentioned above, it repeats "developments that seem to be progressing, but may not be" for dozens of hours, yet the story finally starts moving forward in the second half. Signs emerge that the plot threads spun out in Cold Steel I–II are gradually being tied up, and things begin to heat up.

blocks.source: ラストダンジョンで全てが明かされるのか――と、半信半疑に期待したが、案の定そうはならなかった。
blocks.translation: I was cautiously optimistic, wondering whether everything would be revealed in the final dungeon—but, as expected, that did not happen.

blocks.source: まさしくぶった斬り。
blocks.translation: It was a complete hack job.

blocks.source: 「１００時間かけてこれか！」と、中途な終わりを覚悟していた僕ですら唖然となった。
blocks.translation: Even I, who had braced myself for an incomplete ending, was left dumbfounded, thinking, "I spent 100 hours on this?!"

blocks.source: 閃１，２も酷かったけど、今回はそれを軽く上回るレベル。
blocks.translation: Cold Steel I and II were bad too, but this easily surpasses them.

blocks.source: 起承転結で言えば、転で終わる。ＤＱ１１で言えば、本編中盤ぐらいの山場で突如終わるような感じ。
blocks.translation: In terms of kishōtenketsu, it ends at the ten—the dramatic turn. In Dragon Quest XI terms, it would be like suddenly ending at a major turning point around the middle of the main story.

blocks.source: というか、中盤までのダラダラした展開を省けば一息に終わりまで持っていけたんじゃないだろうか。
blocks.translation: In fact, if they had cut out the tedious developments up to the midpoint, couldn't they have taken the story straight through to the end?

blocks.source: キャラは魅力的だし話の先も気になる分、実にタチが悪い。
blocks.translation: The characters are appealing, and I am eager to see what happens next, which makes it all the more malicious.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Convenience

blocks.source: ロードに悩まされることはほとんどなく、特に戦闘開始は本当に一瞬。戦闘アニメーションのスキップなども旧作同様に完備されている。
blocks.translation: There is almost no troublesome loading, and battles in particular begin practically instantaneously. Features such as skipping battle animations are also included, just as in the older titles.

blocks.source: 今回は多くの場面で□ボタンによって移動をショートカットできる。街道を行ったり来たりさせられることは少なくなった。
blocks.translation: This time, movement can be fast-tracked with the □ button in many situations. You are less often made to travel back and forth along the highways.

blocks.source: 戦闘システム
blocks.translation: Battle System

blocks.source: 見てくれは閃１～２と大差ないものの、主に三つの新システムがある。
blocks.translation: Although it looks little different from Cold Steel I–II, it does have three major new systems.

blocks.source: 一つ目はサブのマスタークオーツ。
blocks.translation: The first is the sub Master Quartz.

blocks.source: 強力な効果を持つマスタークオーツを、一人につき二つまで装備できるようになった。二つ目のマスタークオーツは効果が下がるものの、組み合わせによって今までよりもカスタマイズに幅ができる。
blocks.translation: You can now equip up to two powerful Master Quartz per character. The second Master Quartz has reduced effects, but the combinations allow for more customization than before.

blocks.source: 他のゲームに時折あるサブ職業的なものと思って頂ければ。
blocks.translation: You can think of it as something like a secondary class found occasionally in other games.

blocks.source: ……で、これまたここまではよかったのだけど、問題は残り二つ。これらが恐るべきバランスブレイカーになっている。
blocks.translation: ...And while things were fine up to this point, the problem lies with the remaining two. These are absolutely devastating balance breakers.

blocks.source: 二つ目は『ブレイク』。
blocks.translation: The second is "Break."

blocks.source: 敵にダメージを蓄積すると、動きが止まってフルボッコにできるようになる。要するにまんまＦＦ１３。
blocks.translation: By accumulating damage on an enemy, you can stop it from moving and pummel it relentlessly. In short, it is basically Final Fantasy XIII.

blocks.source: このブレイク状態の敵に攻撃すると、戦術リンク（追撃）が確実に発動する。また、この時にＢＰというポイントが溜まる。
blocks.translation: When you attack an enemy in Break status, a Tactical Link (follow-up attack) is guaranteed to activate. BP also accumulates at this time.

blocks.source: そして三つ目は『ブレイブオーダー』。
blocks.translation: And the third is "Brave Orders."

blocks.source: 上述のＢＰを消費して、全体へ補助をかけるというもの。
blocks.translation: They consume the BP mentioned above to apply support effects to the entire party.

blocks.source: これがとんでもなく凶悪で……
blocks.translation: These are outrageously powerful...

blocks.source: 敵のあらゆる攻撃を反射する。
blocks.translation: Reflects all enemy attacks.

blocks.source: 素早さ三倍強に加速。
blocks.translation: Accelerates speed to more than triple.

blocks.source: ブレイク率を＋３００％強化。
blocks.translation: Increases the Break rate by more than +300%.

blocks.source: 即時に全員へターンが回る。
blocks.translation: Immediately grants everyone a turn.

blocks.source: ＥＰ消費１／５。
blocks.translation: EP consumption reduced to 1/5.

blocks.source: といったとんでもない効果になっている。
blocks.translation: Those are the kinds of outrageous effects they provide.

blocks.source: 効果時間はそれほど長くないのだが、それでも凄まじいバランスブレイカー。
blocks.translation: The effects do not last all that long, but they are still an astonishing balance breaker.

blocks.source: 具体的にこれでどんな戦術が成り立つかというと……
blocks.translation: Specifically, what kind of strategy can you build around this...?

blocks.source: ブレイク強化のオーダーで敵を一気にブレイクする。
blocks.translation: Use a Break-boosting Order to Break the enemy all at once.

blocks.source: 動きが止まった敵を加速のオーダーでフルボッコ。消費したＢＰもすぐ回復。
blocks.translation: Pummel the immobilized enemy with an acceleration Order. The BP you spent also recovers immediately.

blocks.source: ようやく立て直した敵をブレイク強化のオーダーで（略）。
blocks.translation: Use a Break-boosting Order on the enemy that has finally recovered (...).

blocks.source: このような流れで「ずっと俺のターン」ができてしまう。
blocks.translation: Following this sequence, you can pull off "it's always my turn."

blocks.source: というか、大抵のボス戦は２．の時点で終わってしまう始末。
blocks.translation: Actually, most boss battles are already over by step 2.

blocks.source: 味方の強化に対抗するためか、今作の敵は少し強めに設定されている。そのため、序盤は意外と苦戦させられたりする。
blocks.translation: Perhaps to counter the party's enhancements, the enemies in this game have been set a little stronger. As a result, they can put up surprisingly tough fights early on.

blocks.source: もっとも、それは序盤だけ。中盤からは味方の強化がそれを遥かに上回る。
blocks.translation: That said, this only applies to the early game. From the middle onward, the party's enhancements far surpass them.

blocks.source: 中盤以降の戦闘は、ザコ戦はもちろんボス戦もノーダメージに近い楽勝がほとんどだった。
blocks.translation: From the middle of the game onward, battles were almost always easy victories with near-zero damage—not only against regular enemies, but even against bosses.

blocks.source: というか、ラスボス（騎神戦じゃないほう）がノーダメージで楽勝できてしまった。
blocks.translation: In fact, I was even able to beat the final boss (the one that isn't a Divine Knight battle) without taking any damage.

blocks.source: それでいて、ＨＰが減れば強力な攻撃をしかけてくるボスが多い。半端な攻撃をすれば反撃で一気にやられることも。
blocks.translation: Even so, many bosses launch powerful attacks once their HP drops. A half-hearted attack can sometimes result in being wiped out by a counterattack.

blocks.source: そのため、なおのこと敵にターンを回さずハメ殺す戦術が定石となってしまう。
blocks.translation: As a result, the standard strategy becomes even more heavily focused on killing enemies without giving them a turn.

blocks.source: 閃２も極端だったけど、今回はそれ以上。もはや難しいとか簡単とかいう次元ではなく、「これもうバランス取る気ないよね？」というレベル。
blocks.translation: Trails of Cold Steel II was extreme too, but this goes even further. It's no longer a matter of whether it's difficult or easy—it's at the point where you have to ask, “They aren't even trying to balance this anymore, are they?”

blocks.source: 敵が動く前にフルボッコ。敵の個性も全然分からない。
blocks.translation: Pummel the enemies before they can move. You never get a sense of their individual traits.

blocks.source: 属性も気にせず無属性でフルボッコ。
blocks.translation: Pummel them with non-elemental attacks without even worrying about affinities.

blocks.source: 敵の攻撃に対して対処を考える必要もない。防御も回復もいらない。
blocks.translation: There's no need to think about how to deal with enemy attacks. You don't need defense or healing.

blocks.source: ＢＰが溜まらないのでアーツ（術）も不要。クラフト（技）だけでよい。
blocks.translation: Since BP doesn't build up, Arts (spells) aren't necessary either. Crafts (Techs) are all you need.

blocks.source: お陰でただ突き進むだけの場面が多くなってしまう。戦闘システムは凝っているはずなのに、実際のプレイ感覚はなんだか単調。
blocks.translation: As a result, there are more and more scenes where you simply push forward. The battle system is supposed to be elaborate, yet the actual gameplay feels strangely monotonous.

blocks.source: なんというか、ＲＰＧのよさってゲームシステムとストーリーの相乗効果にあると思うわけでして。
blocks.translation: I suppose what makes RPGs great is the synergistic effect between the game system and the story.

blocks.source: ストーリー上の宿敵はやはり手強い。
blocks.translation: The story's nemeses are tough, as expected.

blocks.source: 嫌らしい性格のボスは、嫌らしい攻撃をしてくる。
blocks.translation: Bosses with nasty personalities use nasty attacks.

blocks.source: 敵は炎の使い手なので、水魔法で対抗すべき。
blocks.translation: Since the enemy wields fire, you should counter with water magic.

blocks.source: ……というようなゲーム性とストーリーの一体感が得られないのは、もったいなく思えた。
blocks.translation: I felt it was a shame that I couldn't get that kind of unity between the gameplay and the story.

blocks.source: どんな鳴り物入りで現れたボスも、一方的にボコれるのだから盛り上がらない。継ぎ足し過ぎたシステムが返って遊びの幅を狭めていると感じた。
blocks.translation: No matter how dramatically a boss is introduced, it's not exciting when you can just pummel it one-sidedly. I felt that the system, overloaded with additions, actually narrows the range of ways to play.

blocks.source: ストーリー重視のゲームだし、ヌルゲーならヌルゲーでも構わないと思う。けれど、敵の個性すら感じられないバランスは、ちょっと違うんじゃないかと。
blocks.translation: It's a story-focused game, so I don't mind if it's an easy game. But a balance where you can't even sense the enemies' individual traits feels a little off.

blocks.source: その他で気になったこと。
blocks.translation: Here are some other things that caught my attention.

blocks.source: 戦術リンクの重要性が大幅に増加した結果、演出テンポの悪さも無視できなくなった。
blocks.translation: As the importance of Tactical Links increased substantially, the sluggish pacing of the battle effects became impossible to ignore.

blocks.source: 騎神戦は相変わらず地味。一応、閃２よりもよくなっている気がするけれど、それでも面白いかと言われれば……。
blocks.translation: The Divine Knight battles are still rather plain. I feel they've gotten somewhat better than in Trails of Cold Steel II, but if you ask whether they're fun even so…

blocks.source: わりと早いうちに色々と頭打ちになってしまう。
blocks.translation: Various things reach their limits fairly early on.

blocks.source: マスタークオーツのレベルがクリアよりかなり早くＭＡＸに。中盤で覚えた技が、そのまま最後の技とは……。
blocks.translation: The Master Quartz levels reach MAX long before you clear the game. The technique learned in the middle of the game is already the final one…

blocks.source: カスタマイズが複雑なシステムなのに、イベントでパーティ強制変更を強要される。それなりの長期間だったらいいのだけど、後半はわりと頻繁にある。
blocks.translation: Despite having a complex customization system, events force you to change your party. That would be fine if it lasted for a reasonably long period, but it happens fairly often in the latter half.

blocks.source: 愛用していたキャラがラスダンで抜けたのには困った。
blocks.translation: It was a problem when a character I relied on left the party in the final dungeon.

blocks.source: 戦闘中、画面右側の文字表示（ＨＰ、ＥＰ、ＣＰなど）が妙に小さくて困る。ＦＦ１５もそうだけど、これでなんでＯＫを出してしまったの。大画面で至近距離からやる想定なんですかね？
blocks.translation: During battles, the text displayed on the right side of the screen (HP, EP, CP, and so on) is strangely small, which is frustrating. Final Fantasy XV has the same issue—how did they approve this? Were they assuming people would play on a large screen from very close up?

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: ＰＳ３→ＰＳ４に機種が変わったとはいえ、大きく変わった印象はない。
blocks.translation: Although the platform changed from PS3 to PS4, it doesn't feel like much has changed.

blocks.source: ただ比べてみると明らかに綺麗になっている。頭身の上がった仲間達を見れば、成長を実感できるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: However, when you compare them, it is clearly more beautiful. Seeing the party members with more realistic proportions may make you feel their growth.

blocks.source: また表情の表現も進歩している。よく使われるジト目が印象的。
blocks.translation: Facial expressions have also improved. The frequently used sidelong glare is particularly memorable.

blocks.source: ただ相変わらず、（汗）（！）などのアイコンによる感情表現を、多用しているのが気になった。ＳＦＣ時代じゃあるまいし、時には表情とセリフだけで見せてもよかったんじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: Still, I was bothered by the continued overuse of icons such as (sweat) and (! ) to express emotions. This isn't the SNES era anymore; sometimes they could have conveyed things through facial expressions and dialogue alone.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 個人的には、要所で碧の軌跡や閃の軌跡２などのボス戦曲（アレンジ？）が使われていたのが嬉しかった。もっとも肝心のボス戦内容がアレなので、相乗効果が足りないかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Personally, I was happy to hear boss battle themes (arrangements?) from Trails of Azure and Trails of Cold Steel II, among others, used at key points. However, since the actual boss battles themselves are what they are, the synergistic effect may be lacking.

blocks.source: 戦闘以外だとオープニングの海上要塞とか。ファルコム節の炸裂するラストダンジョンなどが良曲。
blocks.translation: Outside of battles, there's the offshore fortress in the opening, for example. The final dungeon, where Falcom's signature style really shines, also features some great tracks.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 長いのになかなか進まないストーリー。
blocks.translation: A long story that barely moves forward.

blocks.source: 必要性のよく分からないダンジョン（主にアインヘル小要塞）。
blocks.translation: Dungeons whose necessity is difficult to understand (mainly the Einhell Small Fortress).

blocks.source: 重要度の低いサブクエスト。
blocks.translation: Side quests of little importance.

blocks.source: 地味な削り合いになりやすい機甲兵教練。
blocks.translation: Mecha Trooper training, which easily turns into a dull battle of attrition.

blocks.source: 戦闘周りの過剰なシステム。
blocks.translation: An excessive number of systems surrounding battles.

blocks.source: この作品に関しては、削るところを削れば、もっと面白くできたんじゃないかと感じる。ＤＱ１１のように『引き算』のできる開発者がいれば――とつくづく。
blocks.translation: Regarding this game, I feel it could have been much more enjoyable if they had cut the parts that needed cutting. I keep thinking how great it would have been to have developers capable of “subtraction,” as with Dragon Quest XI.

blocks.source: 色々と不満はありながらも楽しめたのは事実。個人的には神ゲー要素も多いと思っているので、次に期待もしています。
blocks.translation: It is true that I enjoyed it despite having various complaints. Personally, I think it has many elements of a masterpiece, so I am also looking forward to the next installment.

blocks.source: けれど、終わり方だけは擁護できず。１レビュアーとしては、とても万人には勧められない。
blocks.translation: However, I can't defend the way it ends. As a reviewer, I absolutely cannot recommend it to everyone.

blocks.source: ただエンディングの表示によれば、次の４こそがようやく帝国編の最後になりそう。半端に終わるのが嫌な人は待ったほうがいいと思う。かなりモヤモヤする終わり方なので。
blocks.translation: However, according to the ending's display, the next installment, 4, finally seems likely to conclude the Empire arc. I think people who dislike stories ending halfway should wait, since the ending is extremely unresolved.

texts.2004年発売の空の軌跡からかれこれ１３年。軌跡シリーズとしては８作目となる。: It has been about 13 years since Trails in the Sky was released in 2004. This is the eighth installment in the Trails series.
texts.続編物なので閃の軌跡１～２のプレイは必須。ストーリー重視のゲームなので、３からや: Since this is a sequel, playing Trails of Cold Steel I–II is essential. This is a story-focused game, so starting with III would clearly be reckless. It would be like reading a manga or novel starting from a volume in the middle.
texts.主人公リィンも続投なので、過去作をやっているかどうかで感情移入度が全然違うと思う: Since protagonist Rean also returns, I think your ability to relate to him is completely different depending on whether you have played the previous games.
texts.空の軌跡、零＆碧の軌跡のキャラがたくさん登場するのもファン感涙。: Fans will also be moved to tears by the many characters from Trails in the Sky and Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure who appear.
texts.特に零＆碧の舞台となったクロスベル市も大きく関わってくるので、あちらもできればプ: In particular, Crossbell City, the setting of Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure, plays a major role, so if possible, you should play those games as well. Trails in the Sky I–III also have more involvement than expected, so playing them would be preferable.
texts.トールズ士官学院を卒業したリィンは、新設された分校の教官として赴任することになる: After graduating from Thors Military Academy, Rean is assigned as an instructor at its newly established branch campus.
texts.中心となるのが新VII組の生徒達５人であり、感覚は閃１に近い。同じことを繰り返し: The five students of the new Class VII are at the center, giving it a feel closer to Trails of Cold Steel I. Although it feels like the same things are being repeated, it is fresher to play than Trails of Cold Steel II, which had begun to feel stale.
texts.とはいうものの、登場人物の大半が既存キャラなのも事実。主要の新キャラ４人や学院関: That said, it is also true that most of the cast consists of existing characters. Aside from the four major new characters and characters connected to the academy, you could almost assume that nearly everyone is returning.
texts.再登場組では、生徒となるアルティナやオーレリア分校長など前作で掘り下げの薄かった: Among the returning characters, significant attention is given to characters who received little development in the previous game, such as Altina, who becomes a student, and Branch Principal Aurelia. Altina in particular was treated almost like the main heroine, which was surprising.
texts.個人的によかったのは、過去作のサブイベントに関連した生徒達が社会人となって再登場: What I personally liked was that students connected to sub-events in previous games reappeared as working adults. They had occupied positions like “colorful NPCs,” but now they appear in voiced event scenes.
texts.過去作で会話をしっかり聞いていたプレイヤーなら、感激できると思う。そうでないプレ: Players who paid close attention to the conversations in the previous games will probably be deeply moved. For players who did not, however, it may become a case of, “Who was this guy again?” …
texts.キャラクター同士のやり取りは相変わらず充実しており、掘り下げも丁寧。: The interactions between the characters remain abundant, and their development is handled carefully.
texts.新しい環境で四苦八苦している主人公が、過去の仲間達と再会するシーンはとても感慨深: The scene where the protagonist, struggling in a new environment, reunites with his former companions is deeply moving.
texts.学院や町での会話も、いつも以上に細かく作り込まれている。マップを一通り回って、主: The conversations at the academy and in the towns are also crafted in greater detail than ever. I sometimes spent several hours simply making the rounds of the maps and listening to the main characters’ conversations.
texts.ストーリーが進行したらまたサブイベントが刷新されたりで、これまた相当な量になって: Whenever the story progressed, the sub-events were refreshed again, making for a considerable amount of content.
texts.サブイベントの大半をこなすようなプレイスタイルで、クリアまで丁度１００時間（難易: Playing in a style that involved completing most of the sub-events, it took me exactly 100 hours to clear the game (on Normal difficulty). ※However, I left things like cooking untouched because they were tedious.
texts.閃１～２はそこまでかからなかったので、ボリュームが増してるかもしれない。: Trails of Cold Steel I–II did not take quite that long, so the amount of content may have increased.
texts.……で、そこまではよかったのだけど、ストーリーの本筋には色々と問題も。: ……And things were good up to that point, but the main storyline also has various problems.
texts.まず気になったのはテンプレ描写の異様な多さ。散々突っ込まれた閃の軌跡２を上回る勢: The first thing that stood out was the absurd abundance of formulaic scenes. It surpasses even Trails of Cold Steel II, which was heavily criticized for this.
texts.閃の軌跡３テンプレの数々: The Many Trails of Cold Steel III Tropes
texts.ピンチになると毎度助っ人が来てくれる。: A helper comes to the rescue every time things get desperate.
texts.敵キャラはまず最初から本気を出さない。: The enemy never starts by fighting seriously.
texts.戦闘でどれだけフルボッコにしても、敵キャラは余裕しゃくしゃく。: No matter how thoroughly you pummel them in battle, the enemy remains completely at ease.
texts.「少しはやるようだが、その程度で俺は倒せん」: "You seem to have some skill, but you cannot defeat me with that."
texts.敵であろうと名前付きのキャラが死ぬことは滅多にない。: Even named enemy characters rarely die.
texts.敵キャラを何度倒しても退場してくれない。神速のデュバリィとか何回目よ？: No matter how many times you defeat an enemy character, they never leave the stage. How many times has Duvalie the Swift shown up now?
texts.人間での戦いが終われば騎神を召喚。とってつけたようにロボ戦が始まる。: Once the battle between humans ends, a Divine Knight is summoned. Then a robot battle starts, tacked on as if by obligation.
texts.ただし、騎神召喚と見せかけて助っ人が入るパターンも多数。: However, there are also many cases where a helper appears instead of the expected Divine Knight summon.
texts.第三者が遠くから高みの見物をしている。: A third party watches from afar, looking down on the proceedings.
texts.「あれが噂にあったVII組の連中か……。少しは楽しませてくれそうだな」: "So those are the members of Class VII I’ve heard rumors about…… They look like they might provide some entertainment."
texts.実力者はその第三者の気配を感じ取れる。: The skilled can sense the presence of that third party.
texts.「フッ、どうやら観客が来ているようだね」: "Heh, it seems we have an audience."
texts.やたらと察しがよい登場人物。基本的に「察しのよさ＝キャラの格」である。: Characters who are remarkably perceptive. Basically, “perceptiveness = status as a character.”
texts.「君達はトールズ士官学院の者だね？」「えっ、どうしてそれを！？」: "You’re from Thors Military Academy, aren’t you?” “Huh? How did you know that!?"
texts.会話が気まずい時は「あ……（察し）」が基本。: When a conversation gets awkward, the standard response is, “Ah…… (I see).”
texts.「俺の親父は五年前に死んだんだ」「あ……」: "My old man died five years ago." "Oh..."
texts.他にも意表を突かれた時など、様々な場面で多用する。: It is also used frequently in various situations, such as when caught off guard.
texts.主人公リィンはとりあえずモテる。好意を寄せるキャラは一桁に留まらない。: The protagonist, Rean, is popular with the ladies. The number of characters who harbor feelings for him is well into the double digits.
texts.特に妹・皇女・ミュゼの三人娘の描写はかなりクドい。: The portrayals of the three girls in particular—his sister, the princess, and Musse—are extremely overdone.
texts.ここまでくると、もはやネタとしてやっているのかもしれない。: At this point, perhaps they are doing it purely as a running gag.
texts.なお、実際のイベントは↓こんな感じになる。: For reference, the actual events play out something like this ↓.
texts.ボス「よく来たな。かかってこい」: Boss "You've come at last. Come and get me."
texts.ボス「まだまだだな。そろそろ本気を出すとしよう」: Boss "You're still no match for me. I think it's time I got serious."
texts.（ノーダメージの楽勝でも膝をついて苦戦した雰囲気）: (Creates the impression of a difficult battle by having them kneel, despite an easy victory without taking damage)
texts.ボス「なかなかやるな。だがこれで条件はそろったぞ！ 来い神機！」: Boss "You're pretty good. But now all the conditions are in place! Come forth, Divine Machine!"
texts.主人公「くっ、このままではやられる」: Protagonist "Damn, we'll be defeated at this rate."
texts.主人公「みんなありがとう。今だ、騎神召喚！」: Protagonist "Thanks, everyone. Now! Knight God Summon!"
texts.（味方のロボ登場で騎神戦）: (Knight God battle after an allied robot appears)
texts.ボス「思ったよりやるが、想定の範囲内だ。ところでそこに誰か隠れているな？」: Boss "You're better than I expected, but still within the anticipated range. By the way, someone is hiding there, aren't they?"
texts.（どこからともなく現れる謎の第三者）: (A mysterious third party appears out of nowhere)
texts.第三者「ふっ、私の存在によくぞ気づいた」: Third Party "Heh, well done noticing my presence."
texts.主人公「いったい何者なんだ！？」: Protagonist "Who in the world are you!?"
texts.第三者「相手をしてやりたいところだが、今日は顔見せなので、この辺にしておいてやろ: Third Party "I'd like to deal with you, but I'm only showing my face today, so I'll let you off here. Farewell."
texts.ボス「俺も用事は済んだので、さらばだ」: Boss "I've finished what I came here to do as well, so farewell."
texts.やや極端に書いたけど、全体的にこんな感じのイベントが多め。一イベントに詰め込んで: I wrote it somewhat extremely, but there are many events like this overall. They cram so much into a single event, while the developments are formulaic and never reach a conclusion. On top of that, they never reveal the mysteries, leaving the impression that everything just drags on.
texts.序盤は敵味方ともに怒涛の勢いで人物が登場。多人数の入り乱れる派手なイベントが展開: At the beginning, characters from both sides—friend and foe alike—appear in a torrent. Flashy events unfold with large numbers of characters caught up in the chaos. ...Or so it seems, but when you take a step back, everyone is merely saying suggestive things, and sometimes the story barely moves forward at all.
texts.話を引っ張りまくるシナリオの都合上、すっきりとした解決がなされることが少ない。: Because the scenario keeps dragging things out, it rarely provides a clear-cut resolution.
texts.そうやって、後半まで同じような展開を繰り返す。何をやっても、誰かの手の平の上とい: The same kind of developments continue repeating all the way into the second half. No matter what you do, it is hard to deny the feeling that you are merely playing into someone else's hands.
texts.脇の会話はよくできているのに、肝心な部分が色々とまずい。ライターの得意不得意があ: The side conversations are well done, yet the crucial parts are problematic in many ways. Is it a matter of each writer's strengths and weaknesses, or is it because the work was divided among multiple writers...? The quality varies considerably.
texts.そして、軌跡シリーズといえば、半端な終わり方をすることで悪名高い。: And speaking of the Trails series, it is infamous for ending in an incomplete fashion.
texts.本作はどうかというと――今までにも増して酷いの一言。: As for this installment—there is only one way to describe it: even worse than before.
texts.上記のように何十時間にも渡って「進んでいるような、いないような展開」を繰り返すが: As mentioned above, it repeats "developments that seem to be progressing, but may not be" for dozens of hours, yet the story finally starts moving forward in the second half. Signs emerge that the plot threads spun out in Cold Steel I–II are gradually being tied up, and things begin to heat up.
texts.ラストダンジョンで全てが明かされるのか――と、半信半疑に期待したが、案の定そうは: I was cautiously optimistic, wondering whether everything would be revealed in the final dungeon—but, as expected, that did not happen.
texts.まさしくぶった斬り。: It was a complete hack job.
texts.「１００時間かけてこれか！」と、中途な終わりを覚悟していた僕ですら唖然となった。: Even I, who had braced myself for an incomplete ending, was left dumbfounded, thinking, "I spent 100 hours on this?!"
texts.閃１，２も酷かったけど、今回はそれを軽く上回るレベル。: Cold Steel I and II were bad too, but this easily surpasses them.
texts.起承転結で言えば、転で終わる。ＤＱ１１で言えば、本編中盤ぐらいの山場で突如終わる: In terms of kishōtenketsu, it ends at the ten—the dramatic turn. In Dragon Quest XI terms, it would be like suddenly ending at a major turning point around the middle of the main story.
texts.というか、中盤までのダラダラした展開を省けば一息に終わりまで持っていけたんじゃな: In fact, if they had cut out the tedious developments up to the midpoint, couldn't they have taken the story straight through to the end?
texts.キャラは魅力的だし話の先も気になる分、実にタチが悪い。: The characters are appealing, and I am eager to see what happens next, which makes it all the more malicious.
texts.ロードに悩まされることはほとんどなく、特に戦闘開始は本当に一瞬。戦闘アニメーショ: There is almost no troublesome loading, and battles in particular begin practically instantaneously. Features such as skipping battle animations are also included, just as in the older titles.
texts.今回は多くの場面で□ボタンによって移動をショートカットできる。街道を行ったり来た: This time, movement can be fast-tracked with the □ button in many situations. You are less often made to travel back and forth along the highways.
texts.見てくれは閃１～２と大差ないものの、主に三つの新システムがある。: Although it looks little different from Cold Steel I–II, it does have three major new systems.
texts.一つ目はサブのマスタークオーツ。: The first is the sub Master Quartz.
texts.強力な効果を持つマスタークオーツを、一人につき二つまで装備できるようになった。二: You can now equip up to two powerful Master Quartz per character. The second Master Quartz has reduced effects, but the combinations allow for more customization than before.
texts.他のゲームに時折あるサブ職業的なものと思って頂ければ。: You can think of it as something like a secondary class found occasionally in other games.
texts.……で、これまたここまではよかったのだけど、問題は残り二つ。これらが恐るべきバラ: ...And while things were fine up to this point, the problem lies with the remaining two. These are absolutely devastating balance breakers.
texts.敵にダメージを蓄積すると、動きが止まってフルボッコにできるようになる。要するにま: By accumulating damage on an enemy, you can stop it from moving and pummel it relentlessly. In short, it is basically Final Fantasy XIII.
texts.このブレイク状態の敵に攻撃すると、戦術リンク（追撃）が確実に発動する。また、この: When you attack an enemy in Break status, a Tactical Link (follow-up attack) is guaranteed to activate. BP also accumulates at this time.
texts.上述のＢＰを消費して、全体へ補助をかけるというもの。: They consume the BP mentioned above to apply support effects to the entire party.
texts.素早さ三倍強に加速。: Accelerates speed to more than triple.
texts.ブレイク率を＋３００％強化。: Increases the Break rate by more than +300%.
texts.といったとんでもない効果になっている。: Those are the kinds of outrageous effects they provide.
texts.効果時間はそれほど長くないのだが、それでも凄まじいバランスブレイカー。: The effects do not last all that long, but they are still an astonishing balance breaker.
texts.具体的にこれでどんな戦術が成り立つかというと……: Specifically, what kind of strategy can you build around this...?
texts.ブレイク強化のオーダーで敵を一気にブレイクする。: Use a Break-boosting Order to Break the enemy all at once.
texts.動きが止まった敵を加速のオーダーでフルボッコ。消費したＢＰもすぐ回復。: Pummel the immobilized enemy with an acceleration Order. The BP you spent also recovers immediately.
texts.ようやく立て直した敵をブレイク強化のオーダーで（略）。: Use a Break-boosting Order on the enemy that has finally recovered (...).
texts.このような流れで「ずっと俺のターン」ができてしまう。: Following this sequence, you can pull off "it's always my turn."
texts.というか、大抵のボス戦は２．の時点で終わってしまう始末。: Actually, most boss battles are already over by step 2.
texts.味方の強化に対抗するためか、今作の敵は少し強めに設定されている。そのため、序盤は: Perhaps to counter the party's enhancements, the enemies in this game have been set a little stronger. As a result, they can put up surprisingly tough fights early on.
texts.もっとも、それは序盤だけ。中盤からは味方の強化がそれを遥かに上回る。: That said, this only applies to the early game. From the middle onward, the party's enhancements far surpass them.
texts.中盤以降の戦闘は、ザコ戦はもちろんボス戦もノーダメージに近い楽勝がほとんどだった: From the middle of the game onward, battles were almost always easy victories with near-zero damage—not only against regular enemies, but even against bosses.
texts.というか、ラスボス（騎神戦じゃないほう）がノーダメージで楽勝できてしまった。: In fact, I was even able to beat the final boss (the one that isn't a Divine Knight battle) without taking any damage.
texts.それでいて、ＨＰが減れば強力な攻撃をしかけてくるボスが多い。半端な攻撃をすれば反: Even so, many bosses launch powerful attacks once their HP drops. A half-hearted attack can sometimes result in being wiped out by a counterattack.
texts.そのため、なおのこと敵にターンを回さずハメ殺す戦術が定石となってしまう。: As a result, the standard strategy becomes even more heavily focused on killing enemies without giving them a turn.
texts.閃２も極端だったけど、今回はそれ以上。もはや難しいとか簡単とかいう次元ではなく、: Trails of Cold Steel II was extreme too, but this goes even further. It's no longer a matter of whether it's difficult or easy—it's at the point where you have to ask, “They aren't even trying to balance this anymore, are they?”
texts.敵が動く前にフルボッコ。敵の個性も全然分からない。: Pummel the enemies before they can move. You never get a sense of their individual traits.
texts.属性も気にせず無属性でフルボッコ。: Pummel them with non-elemental attacks without even worrying about affinities.
texts.敵の攻撃に対して対処を考える必要もない。防御も回復もいらない。: There's no need to think about how to deal with enemy attacks. You don't need defense or healing.
texts.ＢＰが溜まらないのでアーツ（術）も不要。クラフト（技）だけでよい。: Since BP doesn't build up, Arts (spells) aren't necessary either. Crafts (Techs) are all you need.
texts.お陰でただ突き進むだけの場面が多くなってしまう。戦闘システムは凝っているはずなの: As a result, there are more and more scenes where you simply push forward. The battle system is supposed to be elaborate, yet the actual gameplay feels strangely monotonous.
texts.なんというか、ＲＰＧのよさってゲームシステムとストーリーの相乗効果にあると思うわ: I suppose what makes RPGs great is the synergistic effect between the game system and the story.
texts.ストーリー上の宿敵はやはり手強い。: The story's nemeses are tough, as expected.
texts.嫌らしい性格のボスは、嫌らしい攻撃をしてくる。: Bosses with nasty personalities use nasty attacks.
texts.敵は炎の使い手なので、水魔法で対抗すべき。: Since the enemy wields fire, you should counter with water magic.
texts.……というようなゲーム性とストーリーの一体感が得られないのは、もったいなく思えた: I felt it was a shame that I couldn't get that kind of unity between the gameplay and the story.
texts.どんな鳴り物入りで現れたボスも、一方的にボコれるのだから盛り上がらない。継ぎ足し: No matter how dramatically a boss is introduced, it's not exciting when you can just pummel it one-sidedly. I felt that the system, overloaded with additions, actually narrows the range of ways to play.
texts.ストーリー重視のゲームだし、ヌルゲーならヌルゲーでも構わないと思う。けれど、敵の: It's a story-focused game, so I don't mind if it's an easy game. But a balance where you can't even sense the enemies' individual traits feels a little off.
texts.その他で気になったこと。: Here are some other things that caught my attention.
texts.戦術リンクの重要性が大幅に増加した結果、演出テンポの悪さも無視できなくなった。: As the importance of Tactical Links increased substantially, the sluggish pacing of the battle effects became impossible to ignore.
texts.騎神戦は相変わらず地味。一応、閃２よりもよくなっている気がするけれど、それでも面: The Divine Knight battles are still rather plain. I feel they've gotten somewhat better than in Trails of Cold Steel II, but if you ask whether they're fun even so…
texts.わりと早いうちに色々と頭打ちになってしまう。: Various things reach their limits fairly early on.
texts.マスタークオーツのレベルがクリアよりかなり早くＭＡＸに。中盤で覚えた技が、そのま: The Master Quartz levels reach MAX long before you clear the game. The technique learned in the middle of the game is already the final one…
texts.カスタマイズが複雑なシステムなのに、イベントでパーティ強制変更を強要される。それ: Despite having a complex customization system, events force you to change your party. That would be fine if it lasted for a reasonably long period, but it happens fairly often in the latter half.
texts.愛用していたキャラがラスダンで抜けたのには困った。: It was a problem when a character I relied on left the party in the final dungeon.
texts.戦闘中、画面右側の文字表示（ＨＰ、ＥＰ、ＣＰなど）が妙に小さくて困る。ＦＦ１５も: During battles, the text displayed on the right side of the screen (HP, EP, CP, and so on) is strangely small, which is frustrating. Final Fantasy XV has the same issue—how did they approve this? Were they assuming people would play on a large screen from very close up?
texts.ＰＳ３→ＰＳ４に機種が変わったとはいえ、大きく変わった印象はない。: Although the platform changed from PS3 to PS4, it doesn't feel like much has changed.
texts.ただ比べてみると明らかに綺麗になっている。頭身の上がった仲間達を見れば、成長を実: However, when you compare them, it is clearly more beautiful. Seeing the party members with more realistic proportions may make you feel their growth.
texts.また表情の表現も進歩している。よく使われるジト目が印象的。: Facial expressions have also improved. The frequently used sidelong glare is particularly memorable.
texts.ただ相変わらず、（汗）（！）などのアイコンによる感情表現を、多用しているのが気に: Still, I was bothered by the continued overuse of icons such as (sweat) and (! ) to express emotions. This isn't the SNES era anymore; sometimes they could have conveyed things through facial expressions and dialogue alone.
texts.個人的には、要所で碧の軌跡や閃の軌跡２などのボス戦曲（アレンジ？）が使われていた: Personally, I was happy to hear boss battle themes (arrangements?) from Trails of Azure and Trails of Cold Steel II, among others, used at key points. However, since the actual boss battles themselves are what they are, the synergistic effect may be lacking.
texts.戦闘以外だとオープニングの海上要塞とか。ファルコム節の炸裂するラストダンジョンな: Outside of battles, there's the offshore fortress in the opening, for example. The final dungeon, where Falcom's signature style really shines, also features some great tracks.
texts.長いのになかなか進まないストーリー。: A long story that barely moves forward.
texts.必要性のよく分からないダンジョン（主にアインヘル小要塞）。: Dungeons whose necessity is difficult to understand (mainly the Einhell Small Fortress).
texts.地味な削り合いになりやすい機甲兵教練。: Mecha Trooper training, which easily turns into a dull battle of attrition.
texts.戦闘周りの過剰なシステム。: An excessive number of systems surrounding battles.
texts.この作品に関しては、削るところを削れば、もっと面白くできたんじゃないかと感じる。: Regarding this game, I feel it could have been much more enjoyable if they had cut the parts that needed cutting. I keep thinking how great it would have been to have developers capable of “subtraction,” as with Dragon Quest XI.
texts.色々と不満はありながらも楽しめたのは事実。個人的には神ゲー要素も多いと思っている: It is true that I enjoyed it despite having various complaints. Personally, I think it has many elements of a masterpiece, so I am also looking forward to the next installment.
texts.けれど、終わり方だけは擁護できず。１レビュアーとしては、とても万人には勧められな: However, I can't defend the way it ends. As a reviewer, I absolutely cannot recommend it to everyone.
texts.ただエンディングの表示によれば、次の４こそがようやく帝国編の最後になりそう。半端: However, according to the ending's display, the next installment, 4, finally seems likely to conclude the Empire arc. I think people who dislike stories ending halfway should wait, since the ending is extremely unresolved.
